seo.title: 2nd Annual Gala – December 1, 2026 | Chabad of Fredericksburg
seo.description: Join Chabad of Fredericksburg for the 2nd Annual Gala on December 1, 2026 at 6:00 PM: dinner, a live musical evening with the Shavrock Band, and digital tributes. RSVP or sponsor.
